item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 7 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 7 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 PM, 17 August 2026(Monday)

RED WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Metro Manila, Zambales(Subic, Olongapo, San Antonio, Castillejos), Pampanga(Floridablanca, Lubao, Sasmuan, Macabebe, Masantol), Bulacan(Obando, Bulakan, Malolos, Meycauayan, Hagonoy, Paombong), Rizal(San Mateo, Rodriguez, Antipolo, Cainta, Taytay) and Cavite(Bacoor, Cavite City, Imus, Kawit, Noveleta, Rosario).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Serious FLOODING is expected in flood-prone areas.

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales(Botolan, San Marcelino, Cabangan, Candelaria, Iba, Masinloc, Palauig, Santa Cruz, San Felipe, San Narciso), Pampanga(Porac, Minalin, Guagua, Santa Rita), Bulacan(Balagtas, Bocaue, Calumpit, Guiguinto, Marilao, Plaridel, San Jose del Monte, Santa Maria), Cavite(General Emilio Aguinaldo, Magallanes, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Carmona, Trece Martires, Dasmarinas, Naic, Maragondon, Ternate, General Trias, Tanza), Batangas(Nasugbu, Balayan, Calatagan, Lian, Tuy), Laguna(San Pedro, Binan) and Rizal(Baras, Tanay, Binangonan, Cardona, Morong, Teresa, Angono).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Tarlac(Mayantoc, San Clemente, Santa Ignacia, Camiling, Bamban, Capas, San Jose), Pampanga(Apalit, Bacolor, San Fernando, Mexico, San Luis, San Simon, Santa Ana, Santo Tomas, Angeles, Mabalacat), Rizal(Jala-Jala, Pililla), Laguna(Santa Maria, Mabitac, Famy, Cabuyao, Santa Rosa, Siniloan, Pangil, Pakil), Bulacan(Angat, Baliuag, Bustos, Norzagaray, Pandi, Pulilan, Dona Remedios Trinidad, San Rafael), Cavite(Mendez, Tagaytay, Alfonso, Indang, Silang, Amadeo) and Batangas(Calaca, Laurel, Lemery).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, Quezon, Laguna(Alaminos, Bay, Calauan, Liliw, Los Banos, Luisiana, Magdalena, Majayjay, Nagcarlan, Pagsanjan, Pila, Rizal, San Pablo, Santa Cruz, Victoria, Cavinti, Kalayaan, Lumban, Paete, Calamba), Bulacan(San Ildefonso, San Miguel), Pampanga(Arayat, Candaba, Magalang), Tarlac(Concepcion, Anao, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Moncada) and Batangas(Alitagtag, Batangas City, Bauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Lipa, Lobo, Mabini, Mataasnakahoy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Jose, San Juan, San Luis, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Santo Tomas, Taal, Taysan, Tingloy, Balete, Tanauan, Malvar, Agoncillo, San Nicolas, Talisay) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
